changes.summary: Add a snapshot-bound literal source search. Text remains metadata search; source reads snapshot bytes.

request_extension.query: non-empty literal, case-sensitive; empty is rejected

response_extension.source_matches: path, blob_digest, 1-based line/column, byte range, bounded text, entity_ids
response_extension.pagination: returned, has_more, total (null while paging), resumed, scan_complete, files_scanned, bytes_scanned, non_utf8_files, scan_byte_limit

changes.limits: literal byte search only; no tokenizer/FTS/embeddings; 256 MiB scan budget; non-UTF-8 files are skipped and make coverage partial

changes.summary: Traversal results must expose cross-page relations and explicit truncation.

response_extension.boundary_edges: relations incident to this page but with one endpoint outside it, including a missing-endpoint stub
response_extension.pagination: offset, page_size, returned, total, has_more, boundary_edges_truncated, edge_scan_truncated

changes.behavior: merging pages by relation id reconstructs every edge incident to the paged nodes; a 200001-row scan reports partial coverage instead of an unreachable overflow branch

changes.summary: Context selection uses the objective and a deterministic cursor.

request_extension.cursor: optional opaque cursor bound to snapshot and request digest

response_extension.page: offset, candidate_count, returned_entities, has_more, seed_source, fallback

changes.behavior: objective tokens seed name/source matches; one bounded relation hop adds neighbors; unrelated claims are aggregated as omissions; a tight budget resumes the same deterministic candidate order

changes.summary: Request cooperative cancellation of an active scenario without acquiring the Store mutex.

request.project_id: required; the cancellation key is (project_id, run_id)

changes.behavior: scenario execution is split into prepare (Store), execute (no Store), finalize (Store); the cancel flag is independent of the Store and is removed when the run finishes

changes.summary: tools/list is generated from implemented handlers, not the declaration file.
changes.unavailable: other contract tools report requires_grant or not_implemented through archmeld_capabilities and are not advertised as callable
